name: signature
title: Signature
description: A name signed in the script font with the pen's flourish under it: a swoosh with a loop that flicks up past the last letter. The name is ordinary text; the flourish is a drawing that can write itself on.

a11y: The name is real text in the page, read by a screen reader; the flourish is aria-hidden. A signature is not proof of anything: say who signed in text if it matters.
The name text is not clipped by the flourish; the drawing spills 20 px beyond its box and never takes a click.
Reduced motion zeroes the signing animation.
